ei.title: A Request for a Salary Raise
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Dear Mr. Krull, I have greatly enjoyed working at Trincom Enterprises as a sales manager. Since I joined in 2015, I have been a loyal and essential member of this company, and have developed innovative ways to contribute to the company. Moreover, in the last year alone, I have brought in two new major clients to the company, increasing the company's total sales by 5%. Also, I have voluntarily trained 5 new members of staff, totaling 35 hours. I would therefore request your consideration in raising my salary, which I believe reflects my performance as well as the industry average. I look forward to speaking with you soon. Kimberly Morss

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Krull, I have greatly (A)[enjoyed / disliked] working at Trincom Enterprises as a sales manager. Since I joined in 2015, I have been a loyal and (B)[essential / minor] member of this company, and have (C)[abandoned / developed] innovative ways to contribute to the company. Moreover, in the last year alone, I have brought in two new major clients to the company, increasing the company's total sales by 5%. Also, I have voluntarily trained 5 new members of staff, totaling 35 hours. I would therefore request your consideration in raising my salary, which I believe reflects my performance as well as the industry average. I look forward to speaking with you soon. Kimberly Morss
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: ① (A) enjoyed(즐겼다) (B) essential(필수적인) (C) developed(개발했다) 원문 그대로
det.analysis:
✅ ① enjoyed(즐겼다) + essential(필수적인) + developed(개발했다) ← 정답
❌ ② disliked(싫어했다) ≠ enjoyed
❌ ③ minor(사소한) ≠ essential, abandoned(버렸다) ≠ developed
❌ ④ disliked(싫어했다) ≠ enjoyed, abandoned(버렸다) ≠ developed

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Krull, I have greatly enjoyed working at Trincom Enterprises as a sales manager. Since I joined in 2015, I have been a loyal and essential member of this company, and have developed (A)[innovative / outdated] ways to (B)[contribute / harm] to the company. Moreover, in the last year alone, I have brought in two new major clients to the company, (C)[reducing / increasing] the company's total sales by 5%. Also, I have voluntarily trained 5 new members of staff, totaling 35 hours. I would therefore request your consideration in raising my salary, which I believe reflects my performance as well as the industry average. I look forward to speaking with you soon. Kimberly Morss
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: ② (A) innovative(혁신적인) (B) contribute(기여하다) (C) increasing(증가시키는) 원문 그대로
det.analysis:
❌ ① outdated(구식의) ≠ innovative
✅ ② innovative(혁신적인) + contribute(기여하다) + increasing(증가시키는) ← 정답
❌ ③ harm(해치다) ≠ contribute, reducing(줄이는) ≠ increasing
❌ ④ outdated(구식의) ≠ innovative, harm(해치다) ≠ contribute

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Krull, I have greatly enjoyed working at Trincom Enterprises as a sales manager. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: ③ (A) voluntarily(자발적으로) (B) request(요청하다) (C) raising(인상하는) 원문 그대로
det.analysis:
❌ ① reluctantly(마지못해) ≠ voluntarily
❌ ② refuse(거절하다) ≠ request
✅ ③ voluntarily(자발적으로) + request(요청하다) + raising(인상하는) ← 정답
❌ ④ reluctantly(마지못해) ≠ voluntarily, refuse(거절하다) ≠ request, lowering(낮추는) ≠ raising

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ reducing → increasing: 총 매출을 증가시켰다(increasing)는 성과 자랑 문맥
det.analysis:
❌ ① enjoyed: 영업 매니저로 일한 것을 즐겼다, 문맥 적절

❌ ② loyal: 충성스러운 구성원, 문맥 적절

❌ ③ innovative: 혁신적인 방법, 문맥 적절

✅ ④ reducing → increasing: 'increasing the company's total sales by 5%'가 원문. 고객 유치로 매출을 올렸다는 성과이므로 reducing(줄이는)은 정반대 ← 정답

det.korean: ① dishonest → loyal: 충성스러운(loyal) 구성원이었다는 자기 자랑 문맥
